description:
Move the acyclic dependency-graph proptest strategy out of the hierarchy test module into `jit::test_harness`, so other library unit tests can generate issue graphs from the same strategy.

## Background

- `arbitrary_dag` (`crates/jit/src/graph/hierarchy.rs:1121`) is private to the hierarchy test module; it yields acyclic graphs by letting each node depend only on lower-indexed nodes.
- `jit::test_harness` compiles under `cfg(any(test, feature = "test-support"))` (`crates/jit/src/lib.rs:35-36`). `proptest` is a dev-dependency only (`crates/jit/Cargo.toml:109`), and `jit-server` enables `jit/test-support` for its own tests (`crates/server/Cargo.toml:70`), where jit compiles without `proptest`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The strategy is defined once in `jit::test_harness` behind `#[cfg(test)]`, so a build with `test-support` but without the dev-dependencies compiles.
- [hard] REQ-02: The hierarchy tests generate their graphs from it, keep their assertions and pass, and `graph/hierarchy.rs` defines no strategy of its own.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: The acyclic-graph proptest strategy lives in the test harness
